name: Cove Beach ADU
role: Finishing contractor for West Coast Turnkey
description: A detached guest house built alongside the main Cove Beach residence, set into the same rock bluff above the ocean. West Coast Turnkey handed Renova the entire finishing scope: mitered cedar rainscreen siding with true waterfall corners outside, then doors, trim, cabinetry and countertops inside.
scope: Complete finishing package: cedar siding, doors, trim, cabinetry, countertops
